overtreding van artikel 6.2, eerste lid, van de Waterwet
rationale: The decision directly adjudicates an administrative enforcement order (last onder dwangsom) imposed by the Minister for discharging substances into a surface water body without a required permit or exemption under Article 6.2(1) of the Dutch Waterwet (Water Act). Because the primary dispute concerns unpermitted discharge into surface water under the Waterwet permit/exemption regime, it is substantively WATER under both labels and falls under regulatory_permit, with no household connection refusal or informal settlement issue.
